_what: Settings of keep-a-local-file.mjs: `most_files` is the most files one run keeps (a list keeps each in order; a file past the bound is never started). A file above the whole-file threshold (records-door large-file.json) goes over the lease road; a smaller one in pieces. The name and media type rules are the module's.
_compare_most_bytes: A keep the files tool refused onto a name that already holds a file of the same length is compared by content identity, and answers that file as kept when they match; a file over this many bytes is not read to compare and keeps its refusal (the whole-file threshold of records-door large-file.json, 64 MiB).
